title: Exploring Bias and Prediction Metrics to Characterise the Fairness of Machine Learning for Equity-Centered Public Health Decision-Making: A Narrative Review
reasoning: The paper identifies and discusses 'Ethical Non-Alignment' and 'Regulatory and Ethical Oversight' as core categories within its review of algorithmic bias. It treats ethical implications not just as a limitation, but as a fundamental component of characterizing fairness in public health machine learning.
